entities.name: Battle of Nagashino
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary:
The Battle of Nagashino, fought on July 8, 1575, was a pivotal event in Japanese history where the combined forces of Oda Nobunaga and Tokugawa Ieyasu decisively defeated the Takeda clan, employing innovative tactics and artillery that would influence the development of warfare in East Asia.

This battle took place within the grounds of Nagashino Castle in modern-day Aichi Prefecture, resulting in the destruction of the Takeda army and the eventual unification of Japan under Tokugawa rule.

The Battle of Nagashino is often cited as a turning point in Japanese history, marking the beginning of the end of the Sengoku period and the rise of the Tokugawa shogunate, which would rule Japan for the next 250 years.

As Tokugawa Ieyasu would later recall, 'The victory at Nagashino was a great blessing, and I was able to establish the foundation for the Tokugawa regime.'
